text: As I stand here, I am struck by the contrast between the cold, geometric glass-walled room filled with bags and the vibrant, energetic display of "R+D" nearby. The glass room feels sterile and quiet, almost isolating, while the R+D exhibit pulses with ideas and movement—words leaping off the wall, hinting at the possibilities of human innovation. I feel simultaneously distant from the world—an observer through barriers—and irresistibly drawn forward by the energy of discovery. This contradiction heightens my curiosity and self-awareness in the space.
